title: Recovery pre-live evidence and registration topology closure

phases.objective: Make all remaining Recovery readiness gaps fail closed in repository code: explicit runtime class, signed external registration/OAuth/network/Worker evidence, replay-store topology, and complete Core/Recovery registration collision modeling without enabling Production.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging Recovery readiness remains blocked unless the same signed evidence envelope binds ChatGPT registration, OAuth browser flow, origin network isolation, deployed Worker provenance, deployment SHA, runtime class, and target fingerprint.
steps: Resolve a security-sensitive runtime only when its deployment class is explicit.
Read one immutable signed evidence snapshot from the deployment-owned authority.
Validate actual ChatGPT registration and OAuth browser round-trip evidence.
Validate that the origin is network-restricted to the signed Gateway path.
Validate that the deployed Cloudflare Worker bundle and policy belong to the same exact source SHA.
Require a replay store whose scope matches the deployment topology.
Keep production_live false and perform no provider or database mutation.
assertions: Generic staging or production labels cannot establish security-sensitive runtime-class authority.
Local Windows/Docker Staging may use the durable single-filesystem replay store; hosted multi-instance Staging requires shared_deployment replay scope.
Missing or drifted registration, OAuth, network, or deployed Worker evidence blocks readiness.
All evidence is bound to exact deployment SHA, target fingerprint, freshness and signed authority.
Production authority remains disabled and no live action is performed by repository tests.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Admin Core, Tenant Core and Production Recovery registrations sharing auth.mad4b.com are represented explicitly and every host collision requires an approved pair without changing routing.
steps: Load the base Custom GPT surface registry.
Apply the non-overriding canonical registration topology extension.
Bind Production and Staging Core projections to explicit registration sets and action slots.
Validate member schemas, operation budgets, audience/auth profile, server host and output parity.
Reject any same-environment host collision not listed as an explicit pair.
assertions: Production Recovery remains a standalone private registration and is not embedded into Admin Core.
Admin Core and Tenant Core are represented for both Production auth.mad4b.com and Staging dev.mad4b.com.
The extension cannot override existing registration sets or route policy.
production_live remains false and routing_changed remains false.

phases.objective: Repository topology modeling must not grant Production Recovery execution or production_live authority.
blockers: Production activation requires separate governed promotion and operational evidence.
Actual ChatGPT registration, OAuth browser round-trip, network isolation and deployed Worker evidence must be observed live before Staging certification can pass.
No provider, DB, SSH, SQL, migration, grant, deployment or secret mutation is authorized by this PR.
